sentences.text: Learned APP waives service of Rule on behalf of the respondent-State.
2. By way of this application the applicant convict prays for being released on parole leave for the purpose of providing financial assistance to his family.

3. Jail remarks would show that the applicant has been convicted for offence punishable under Section 363, 366, 376 of the Indian Penal Code and under the provisions of the POCSO Act and sentenced to undergo 10 years imprisonment and whereas the applicant appears to have undergone approximately 03 years and 04 months imprisonment.
Jail remarks would also show that the applicant had been lastly released on furlough leave in the month of April-May, 2022 and on parole leave in the month of October, 2022.
The jail remarks would also show that as and when the applicant had been released earlier, he had surrendered in time.
Jail conduct of the applicant is stated to be good.
